Computed numbers match financial-core or backend contracts and expose assumptions, limits, and Swiss legal anchors.
Covers constraints, tradeoffs, alternatives, missing data, and next checks that an expert-grade Swiss guidance flow would raise for the persona.
The user understands what changed, why it matters, what is uncertain, and the next useful action without excess text or role confusion.
Guidance stays educational or simulational, avoids prescriptive product selection, and hands off heavy or irreversible decisions.
Primary content and actions are accessible, robust to text scale, localized, and not clipped or overlapped.
